entities.summary: Mengistu, a notable figure in the history of Ethiopia, associated with Derg Regime and Red Terror (1977–1978). Preceded by Red Terror Campaign and Red Terror Ethiopia 1977. Their legacy influenced Ogaden War with Somalia and 1984 Famine and Live Aid.
